messages:
Alex H: Quick follow-up — I addressed the review comments on the split-rollout PR and changed the flag handling to be opt-in. PTAL when you get a minute. Need to land this ahead of Thu deploy. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/482
Priya S: Skimmed it — looks good overall. left one tiny nit about keeping request_id in the log context (helps tracing).
Alex H: Good catch, added request_id to the logger context and pushed a small fixup commit.
Samir: Thanks. One ask: can we guard against config being null in ServiceConfig.init? I hit a flake locally.
Alex H: Added null guard + unit test (see new test ServiceConfigTest.testNullConfig). Pushed. Running CI now.
Jen C: Can someone with rollout perms grab a canary window? Prefer Thu afternoon UTC. @deploy-bot FYI.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary window request received. Available slots: Thu 14:00 UTC, Thu 20:00 UTC. Reply with slot to reserve.
Jen C: Reserve Thu 14:00 UTC please.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Slot confirmed: Thu 14:00 UTC for canary rollout. Reminder will post 30m prior.
Priya S: Approved :thumbsup: — minor nit already fixed.
Samir: Approved as well. Ran the unit tests locally, all green.
Jen C: Approving too. Plan: merge after green CI, monitor canary metrics for 30m, then complete rollout if no regressions.
Alex H: Thanks everyone — CI went green, merging now.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: CI passed for PR #482. Merge complete. Canary scheduled Thu 14:00 UTC. Logs will stream to #incidents during rollout.
Alex H: Leaving a short post-merge note in the PR describing the rollback condition and metric thresholds. If anyone wants a deeper postmortem after canary, ping me.
Priya S: Nice. No further comments from me.
Samir: Cool — great job moving this quickly.
Jen C: Thanks team.
